chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Love the children and have mercy on them. And when you promise them something, fulfill it for them, for they only see that you are the ones who provide for them.
ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about loving children and keeping promises to them?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches tenderness toward children and urges showing them mercy in conduct. It also emphasizes keeping promises made to them, since children trust their caregivers completely and view them as the source of their provision.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4702 - The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
"Love the children and have mercy on them. When you promise them something, fulfill it for them, for they only perceive that you are the ones who provide for them."
